title: Add CLI tool for task management
body:
Adds `axonctl`, a CLI for managing Axon tasks without writing YAML manifests.

## Implementation

- **Commands**: `create`, `list`, `get`, `delete`, `logs`, `version`
- **Integration**: Uses existing client-go and controller-runtime libraries
- **Auth**: Supports both in-cluster config and kubeconfig files
- **Build**: Added to Makefile, outputs to `bin/axonctl`

## Usage

```bash
# Create a task from command line
axonctl create --type claude-code \
  --prompt "Create a hello world program in Python" \
  --cred-type api-key \
  --secret anthropic-api-key

# List and monitor tasks
axonctl list --all-namespaces
axonctl get my-task
axonctl logs my-task -f
```

## Structure

```
cmd/axonctl/
├── commands/
│   ├── create.go   # Task creation with validation
│   ├── list.go     # Namespace-aware listing
│   ├── get.go      # Detailed task info
│   ├── delete.go   # Task deletion
│   ├── logs.go     # Pod log streaming
│   └── root.go     # Cobra setup and client init
└── main.go
```

Dependencies: Cobra promoted from indirect to direct in go.mod.

title: Implement TaskSpawner CRD
body:
## Summary
- Introduces the **TaskSpawner** CRD that watches external sources (GitHub Issues) and automatically creates Task resources for each discovered item
- Each TaskSpawner gets a dedicated spawner Deployment for isolation, with the main controller managing its lifecycle via finalizer pattern
- Adds a source abstraction layer (`internal/source/`) with a GitHub implementation supporting pagination, auth, label/state filtering, and comment fetching
- Includes CLI support (`axon get taskspawner`), RBAC updates, and a Dockerfile for the spawner binary

## Architecture
```
TaskSpawner (CRD)
  └─ Deployment (spawner pod, created by main controller)
       └─ continuously polls source (e.g. GitHub issues)
            └─ creates Task resources
                 └─ Job → Pod (existing Task flow)
```

## New Files
| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `api/v1alpha1/taskspawner_types.go` | CRD types |
| `internal/source/{source,github,prompt}.go` | Source abstraction + GitHub impl + prompt templates |
| `cmd/spawner/main.go` + `Dockerfile` | Spawner binary |
| `internal/controller/taskspawner_controller.go` | Main reconciler |
| `internal/controller/taskspawner_deployment_builder.go` | Deployment builder |
| `test/integration/taskspawner_test.go` | 4 integration tests |
| `test/e2e/taskspawner_test.go` | E2E tests |
| `internal/source/*_test.go` | 13 unit tests |

## Test plan
